correctness.rationale: For three literal characteristic-two weighted quartic equations, normalize P² coordinates and iterate w∈F_(2^m). Independent finite-field arithmetic evaluated equation and all four gradient components for every weighted-projective point over F2–F64, yielding totals (1,33,25,321,961,4545), (3,37,57,337,993,4417), (1,33,49,321,961,4353) and singular-point counts 1,3,1. Rank 6/4/3 quotient Frobenius representations from the ADE types and Uppal Theorem 3.3 permit Newton recovery from their first r traces, resulting (s+1)^4(s²−s+1), (s+1)^3(s−1), (s+1)^3, hence all-m smooth-locus profiles and the stated H0/H2/H4 zeta denominators. Finite checks alone would not prove all extensions. F4 smooth counts are 32,34,32 and minimal extension is two.
residual_risks: Dependence on the pre-established degree-two singular ADE type and Frobenius root-lattice theorem; finite enumeration verifies point counts but not those geometric inputs.
